provider materializer (materializeS2Subtraction) basket subtraction raster written with hashes
serialized basket px union and overlap equal the materializer counts; every basket carries bbox and px evidence
layer integrity against the S1 owned and muted sets computed from the live board and recorded in the S2 stage receipt (disjointness intersections and remaining-pixel balance)

guarantees.appliesTo: every S2 run with lane s2-basket-assembly ON (default OFF; with the lane off this guarantee is dormant and the stage reproduces the pinned baseline exactly)
guarantees.enforcedBy: ports/early/runEarly.mjs S2 basket assembly block (toolkit stage wiring). recipes/compile.mjs validates only kind/position/consumes/produces/lane and carries this declaration as hashed text; the toolkit compiler has no guarantee evaluator, so enforcement lives in the wiring, not the schema.
guarantees.onFailure: the run fails; an opaque, unwitnessed, or non-reproducing basket assembly is a failed guarantee, not a passed stage
requires: px.baskets.assembly serialized from the branch board into an assembly artifact on disk: for every basket, its named components with roles (the bright body as the declared base, the shell fused onto it) with full pixel lists, the tip anchor with its derivation, and window ownership accounting against the semantic bbox (46x72) with the residue named per basket

assembly inputs are the provider's component evidence re-executed through the S2 snapshot branch (the Basket.findPx body component ref materialized against the px.components bright label field, and the findShellFamily blackPx set cross-checked against the px.baskets.shellFamily member), never the finished px.baskets pixel set

exact reproduction gates against the accepted baseline: every basket's body-first fused set equals the baseline basket's px set element for element (17 of 17), the fused union is 36,362 px with body/shell totals matching the baseline whitePx/blackPx count totals, component overlap is 0 on every basket, and every basket's window residue lies inside the phase-1 analysis band of 1,172 to 1,177 px

independent witnesses: the assembly Calculation re-executed on a second restored S2 branch reproduces the assembly Part exactly (canonical hash), and an independent re-derivation of one basket's body and shell pixel sets from the raster fields by a separate code path (the bright component at the glyph window the semantic bbox and margins imply, and the shell re-derived from the family consensus shell offsets against the dark mask; never reading the basket's recorded findPx body ref or findShellFamily blackPx) matches the serialized assembly for that basket exactly

the assembly op's receipt entry in the run's instrumentation sidecar carries the Calculation's declared emits (basket count, fused union px, total residue px) copied verbatim from the output Part by the phase-1 auto-instrumentation channel
artifact paths and SHA-256 hashes recorded in the S2 stage receipt

materializes: S2 basketPx subtraction raster and layer remaining raster (stage-output/early/artifacts/s2/basketPx.rgba.bin, remaining.rgba.bin)
px.baskets.assembly assembly artifact (stage-output/early/artifacts/s2assembly/px.baskets.assembly.json; lane s2-basket-assembly ON only)

refinements.baseline: The pinned clean S2 contract fuses the basket inline (findPxCalculation unions the materialized bright body pixels with the shell member's blackPx), but the toolkit seam receives the outcome as a finished px array with white/black counts: the body and shell component sets do not cross the seam as named structure, the Part carries no anchor, and ownership against the semantic window is accounted nowhere.
refinements.declaredBy: Sam, 2026-10-17: there is a literal step fusing the Black and White PxSets into the full sprite; per sprite, assembly starts from the more reliable base PxSet and fuses the rest onto it; a basket's reference point is its tip, the bottom of the glyph, where the basket physically stands, and circles and distances are measured from it
refinements.delta: Each Basket Part is re-assembled body-first through the phase-1 assembly shape (ports/early/assembly.mjs): the bright body component set (materialized from the bright label field at the basket's findPx body ref) is the declared base; the shell set (the basket's findShellFamily blackPx, cross-checked element for element against the px.baskets.shellFamily Part member) is fused onto it. The fused set is order-independent, so the delta is structural, not pixel-changing: the Part crosses the seam as named components with roles instead of a flat array, carries its anchor (the tip, glyph origin + (21, 70) within the 46x72 semantic window, with its radial-fit derivation), and accounts ownership against its semantic bbox with the residue named per basket. The base board and px.baskets are never written; the assembly lives only on the branch and in its artifact.
refinements.enforcement: Toolkit layer only: ports/early/s2BasketAssembly.mjs (the assembly Calculation and the independent witness) plus the branch and guarantee block in ports/early/runEarly.mjs, gated by lane s2-basket-assembly through ports/run-stages.mjs. The pinned provider is untouched, and with the lane OFF the stage reproduces the pinned baseline emissions exactly.
refinements.specimenExpectation: On the golden specimen (Dash IMG_5641.jpg) the assembly reproduces all 17 baskets exactly (fused union 36,362 px), component overlap 0 on every basket, per-basket window residue inside the phase-1 analysis band of 1,172 to 1,177 px against the 3,312 px semantic window, with S0, S1 and S3 emissions untouched. This expectation is enforced as exact gates in the wiring (the guarantee certifies reproduction, not a recorded delta), because body-first assembly must not change a single pixel; any differing basket is reported with its differing pixel count.
